answer: Reputation in the EigenTrust matrix decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so authority requires sustained honest service, not a brief burst of activity. Freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming endorsements; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap their credibility alone. Whether an oasis, a marble workshop, or a wharf, each gains standing only through durable, verifiable ties.
